summary: Added diagnostic-only exact-upstream-EXE provenance census support for the five guarded C2CSpeechBubbleGF/GF-heart spacing-only hook RVAs. The analyzer records 24 hook bytes plus closest known direct HUD/sprite CALL before/after each hook within 0x80 bytes in JSON, Markdown and stdout. The backend verifier requires this census contract. No runtime ownership or game/host draw behavior changed.

review_lenses.stereo_correctness: All five guarded hooks remain spacing-only, avoiding unsupported flattening or world-stereo bypass.

provenance_census.interpretation: No known HUD/sprite direct CALL was found within +/-0x80 of any guarded hook. This does not prove absence of indirect or unknown-target draw activity and does not justify ScreenHud promotion.
